votes.motion: Approve work session meeting minutes of May 11, 2021; May 18, 2021; May 25, 2021; September 13, 2022; September 20, 2022; October 18, 2022; November 22, 2022; December 6, 2022; and the formal meeting minutes of September 20, 2022
votes.description: The Council approved multiple past work session and formal meeting minutes spanning 2021 and 2022. This is a routine administrative action to officially adopt the meeting records.

votes.motion: Adopt Joint Ceremonial Resolution 2 of 2023, with Mayor Mendenhall recognizing February as Black History Month in Salt Lake City
votes.description: The Council adopted a joint ceremonial resolution with the Mayor to recognize February as Black History Month in Salt Lake City. The resolution was presented to the Director of the Black Cultural Center at the University of Utah.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer Items B-1 through B-7 to a future Consent Agenda for action
votes.description: The Council closed the joint public hearing for seven grant applications submitted to the Wasatch Front Regional Council and referred them to a future consent agenda for formal action. The grants covered transportation, economic development, and sustainability projects.

votes.motion: Continue the public hearing on the Land Exchange to Facilitate the Bridge to Backman Project to a future date
votes.description: The Council continued the public hearing regarding the proposed transfer of City-owned open space land at 592 N. Riverside Drive to Riverwood Cove, LLC in exchange for an equal-sized parcel, intended to facilitate a new public park and school connection. No public comments were received at this hearing.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action on the zoning map amendment at approximately 704 East 900 South to a future Council meeting
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on a proposed rezone of 704 East 900 South from R-2 to Small Neighborhood Business (SNB) and deferred action to a future meeting. The Planning Commission had forwarded a negative recommendation on the petition.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action on the Rocky Mountain Power Rezone to a future Council meeting
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on the proposed rezone of properties at and near 1223 West North Temple from M-1 and TSA-SP-C to TSA-Urban Center-Core to accommodate Rocky Mountain Power's new office headquarters, and deferred action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action on the Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) Text Amendment to a future Council meeting
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on proposed amendments to Title 21A of the Salt Lake City Code regarding ADU regulations, including eliminating the conditional use requirement for detached ADUs in single-family residential zones, and deferred action to a future meeting.

The Council approved the consent agenda, which included setting public hearing dates for several ordinances and resolutions, and approving the appointment of Julie Bjornstad to the Transportation Advisory Board through September 29, 2025.
